en.tagline: A way forward. Shelter and recovery resources in Tucson and Pima County.
en.home_hero_lead: Free help for anyone facing homelessness, or at risk of losing their home. We point you to shelter, recovery, and support, right now. No catch.
en.home_ce_desc: Coordinated Entry: the front door to housing services
en.home_question_sub: Tap a tile to see places that can help.
en.home_match_sub: Private questionnaire. Your answers stay on your device.
en.dir_near_me_unavailable: Location unavailable. Showing the full list.
en.card_coords_approximate: Map pin is approximate. Call to confirm address.
en.map_lead: Tap a place to call or get directions. Some shelters keep their address private. Find their hotlines below.
en.map_confidential_note: Domestic-violence and some women's shelters keep their location confidential for safety. Find them in the directory.
en.map_hotlines_sub: These shelters keep their address confidential for safety. Call to be connected.
en.map_locate_error: We couldn't get your location. Check your phone's location permission, or browse the list instead.
en.map_hint: Tap a pin to call or get directions
en.map_zoom_hint: Hold {key} and scroll to zoom the map
en.about_intro: Tucson Compass is a free directory of shelter, recovery, food, medical, and other support services in Tucson and Pima County. It is independent and does not require sign-up.
en.about_what_match_p: Answer a few private questions and get a list of services that fit your situation. Takes about a minute. Your answers stay on your device.
en.about_what_browse_p: Search by name or service. Filter by who a provider serves: women, men, families, youth, veterans, LGBTQ+, domestic violence survivors, and more.
en.about_what_map_p: View nearby providers, tap a pin to call or get directions, and sort by what is closest to you.
en.about_what_crisis_p: 911, 988 for mental health, 211 for info and referral, and the 24-hour domestic violence hotline are linked from every page.
en.about_what_languages_t: Use it in English or Spanish.
en.about_what_languages_p: Switch languages anytime. Save the site to your phone's home screen and it will work without a signal.
en.about_independence: Tucson Compass is not affiliated with the organizations listed here. We do not provide shelter, funding, intake, or any direct services. We point you to the providers who do.
en.about_privacy_p: This site does not require sign-in, does not collect personal information, and does not use tracking analytics that profile visitors. Your location, if you choose to share it, is used only on your device to sort the directory. Your Find Your Fit answers never leave your phone.
en.about_data_p: Information is provided as-is and may change. Please call ahead to confirm hours, eligibility, and availability. Listings are compiled from public sources, including the City of Tucson, the Tucson Pima Collaboration to End Homelessness (TPCH), Pima County, and the providers' own websites.
en.about_contact_p: If a listing is out of date or missing, please notify the City of Tucson or the provider directly. They are the authoritative source.
en.err_404_lead: This page doesn't exist, or it moved. The link may have been mistyped. Let's point you back the right way.
en.err_404_crisis: Need help right now? Call 988 for crisis and mental health, or 911 for an emergency.
en.footer_disclaimer: Tucson Compass is an independent, free informational directory. It is not affiliated with, and does not endorse, the organizations listed, and does not provide shelter, funding, food, or services directly. Listings are compiled from public sources and may be incomplete or out of date. Information is provided as-is, without warranty, and is not legal, medical, or crisis advice. Always call ahead to confirm hours, eligibility, and availability before traveling. We are not responsible for the content or services of third-party websites or organizations.
en.footer_tagline: A way forward. Shelter, recovery, and help across Tucson and Pima County.
en.footer_cta_sub: Answer a few questions · 1 minute · Private
en.offline_banner: You're offline. The directory still works, but phone calls and directions will need a signal.
en.install_prompt: Save this site to your device for offline use.
en.install_ios_prompt: To save this site for offline use, tap the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen."
en.match_lead: Answer a few questions and we'll show you the services that fit your situation.
en.match_privacy_title: Your answers stay on your device.
en.match_privacy_body: Nothing is saved, sent, or tracked. Refresh the page and everything is gone. You can skip any question.
en.match_q_needs: What do you need help with right now?
en.match_housing_at_risk: Housed but at risk of losing it
en.match_q_gender_help: Helps match gender-specific shelters. Pick all that apply.
en.match_q_dv: Are you fleeing or recovering from domestic abuse?
en.match_q_sub_help: Some programs require sobriety. Housing First programs welcome you either way.
en.match_sub_not_seeking: Currently using and not seeking treatment
en.match_q_faith: Are faith-based programs OK with you?
en.match_q_faith_help: Many shelters here are Christian (Bible study, chapel). Some are not.
en.match_q_tribal: Are you a tribal / Native American member?
en.match_disclaimer: This is a starting point, not a guarantee of eligibility. Programs have their own intake rules, so call ahead. Some shelters do not accept certain criminal histories (e.g., level 2 or 3 sex offense convictions); the questionnaire does not screen for this.
en.home_match_cta_sub: Answer a few questions and we'll show you what fits your situation.
en.match_crisis_strip_title: In danger or in crisis right now?
en.match_results_sub_one: 1 service that fits. Tap a phone number to call.
en.match_results_sub_many: {n} services that fit. Tap a phone number to call.
en.match_no_match_body: Try fewer answers, or call 2-1-1 for personalized referrals.
en.match_crisis_vet_title: National Call Center for Homeless Veterans
en.res_lead: Tap to call a number or open a website. Need directions to a place? Use the Directory. Crisis lines first.
en.res_note: Links open each organization's own website. Information changes, so call ahead to confirm hours and availability.
en.match_print_note: Call ahead to confirm hours, beds, and eligibility.

es.about_intro: Tucson Compass es un directorio gratuito de refugio, recuperación, comida, atención médica y otros servicios de apoyo en Tucson y el Condado de Pima. Es independiente y no requiere registro.
es.about_what_match_p: Responda algunas preguntas privadas y obtenga una lista de servicios que se ajustan a su situación. Lleva alrededor de un minuto. Sus respuestas se quedan en su dispositivo.
es.about_what_browse_p: Busque por nombre o servicio. Filtre por a quién atiende cada proveedor: mujeres, hombres, familias, jóvenes, veteranos, LGBTQ+, sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica y más.
es.about_what_map_p: Vea proveedores cercanos, toque un punto para llamar o cómo llegar, y ordene por lo más cercano a usted.
es.about_what_crisis_t: Acceda a ayuda en crisis rápido.
es.about_what_crisis_p: 911, 988 para salud mental, 211 para información y referencias, y la línea directa de violencia doméstica 24 horas están enlazados desde cada página.
es.about_what_languages_p: Cambie de idioma en cualquier momento. Guarde el sitio en la pantalla de inicio de su teléfono y funcionará sin señal.
es.about_independence: Tucson Compass no está afiliado a las organizaciones aquí listadas. No proporcionamos refugio, fondos, admisión ni servicios directos. Le indicamos los proveedores que sí los proporcionan.
es.about_privacy_p: Este sitio no requiere iniciar sesión, no recopila información personal y no usa análisis de seguimiento que perfilen a los visitantes. Su ubicación, si elige compartirla, se usa únicamente en su dispositivo para ordenar el directorio. Sus respuestas de Servicios Para Usted nunca salen de su teléfono.
es.about_data_p: La información se proporciona tal cual y puede cambiar. Por favor llame antes para confirmar horario, elegibilidad y disponibilidad. Los listados se recopilan de fuentes públicas, incluyendo la Ciudad de Tucson, la Colaboración Tucson-Pima para Poner Fin a la Falta de Vivienda (TPCH), el Condado de Pima y los sitios web de los propios proveedores.
es.about_contact_p: Si un listado está desactualizado o falta, por favor notifique a la Ciudad de Tucson o al proveedor directamente. Ellos son la fuente autorizada.
es.err_404_lead: Esta página no existe o se movió. Quizás el enlace se escribió mal. Le ayudamos a volver al camino correcto.
es.err_404_crisis: ¿Necesita ayuda ahora? Llame al 988 para crisis y salud mental, o al 911 en una emergencia.
es.footer_disclaimer: Tucson Compass es un directorio informativo independiente y gratuito. No está afiliado a las organizaciones listadas ni las respalda, y no proporciona refugio, fondos, alimentos ni servicios directamente. Los listados se compilan de fuentes públicas y pueden estar incompletos o desactualizados. La información se proporciona tal cual, sin garantía, y no constituye asesoramiento legal, médico ni de crisis. Llame siempre para confirmar horarios, elegibilidad y disponibilidad antes de ir. No somos responsables del contenido ni de los servicios de sitios web u organizaciones de terceros.
es.footer_tagline: Un camino hacia adelante. Refugio, recuperación y ayuda en Tucson y el Condado de Pima.

es.match_privacy_title: Sus respuestas se quedan en su dispositivo.
es.match_privacy_body: Nada se guarda, envía ni rastrea. Recargue la página y todo desaparece. Puede omitir cualquier pregunta.

es.match_disclaimer: Este es un punto de partida, no una garantía de elegibilidad. Los programas tienen sus propias reglas de admisión, así que llame antes. Algunos refugios no aceptan ciertos antecedentes penales (por ejemplo, condenas por delitos sexuales de nivel 2 o 3); el cuestionario no detecta esto.
